Intel develops silicon products and technologies for digital devices. The Cloud Software Development Engineer designs, develops, validates, and optimizes software for cloud, hybrid-cloud, and on-premises environments, integrating Intel hardware features and improving software performance across partner stacks.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and validate software solutions aligned with Intel hardware features and cloud deployment requirements
Collaborate with partners to understand software stacks and optimize full-stack performance, spanning firmware, drivers, OS, middleware, SDKs, frameworks, algorithms, and applications
Participate in the development of reference cloud platform software to enhance product value and support customer designs
Contribute to projects involving data services, AI/ML, and open-source development initiatives
Debug and troubleshoot software issues to ensure seamless functionality across Intel platforms
Stay informed about industry trends and integrate innovative approaches into development processes

Required

1+ years of experience working in a software product development team
1+ years of working experience developing system software for Linux OS
Strong programming skills in C/C++
Hands on Git and GitHub experience
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and their associated development tools
Understanding of software optimization techniques and debugging tools
Preferred

Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
Experience with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes or Docker
Knowledge of AI/ML frameworks and data analytics technologies
Eagerness to learn, adapt, and grow in a fast-paced, innovative environment
An understanding of graphics fundamentals, experience with Linux, or Windows based operating systems and a strong knowledge of system architecture is vital to success in this role
